changes.name: release
changes.impact: Nothing is synced for it: the platform's record and the labels of its objects name the new release.

changes.name: kubernetes.nodeImage
changes.blocking: not supported by this release: the BOM names cluster chart 0.1.14, which cannot order a rollout (it needs 0.1.15 or newer)

changes.name: tenantCharts.kubernetes
changes.impact: The run writes the chart on the provider: new tenants get it. An existing tenant keeps its chart until its own chart upgrade.

changes.name: capi
changes.impact: The Application moves to the new chart version. ArgoCD syncs, and runs the chart's clusterctl hook again, only when the new chart renders an object differently; the hook then finds every provider at its version and changes nothing. No pod of a tenant restarts.

changes.name: pc-platform
changes.impact: The Application moves to the new chart version. ArgoCD syncs only the Cluster API objects of the platform cluster that the new chart renders differently. Before any sync the run checks that no machine or bootstrap template is new and that the control plane is unchanged, and fails with unexpected_rollout otherwise: no machine is replaced.

changes.name: capi-tenant
changes.impact: The Application moves to the new chart version. ArgoCD syncs, and runs the chart's clusterctl hook again, only when the new chart renders an object differently; the hook then finds every provider at its version and changes nothing. No pod of a tenant restarts.

changes.name: platform
changes.impact: The Application moves to the new chart version. ArgoCD syncs only the objects the new chart renders differently, and starts no sync when there is none. No pod of a tenant restarts.

blocking: kubernetes.nodeImage: not supported by this release: the BOM names cluster chart 0.1.14, which cannot order a rollout (it needs 0.1.15 or newer)
